text.en: Rinse spinach several times in cold water.
text.de: Spinat mehrmals in kaltem Wasser waschen.

why.en: It grows in sandy soil, and grit stays on the leaves.
why.de: Er wächst in sandigem Boden, und Sand bleibt an den Blättern.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Spinach grows in sandy soil and must be rinsed repeatedly in cold water to remove all traces of grit from the leaves.
